uncited: A 3D texture volume (`sampler3D`) storing velocity vectors.
**Vertex Shader:** Compute clip-space position using the ModelviewProjection matrix.
**Velocity Sampling:** Convert the world-space position to normalized texture coordinates.
Set clip-space position to the input point's clip-space position.
**Emit Second Vertex:** Calculate the end position by adding the velocity vector to the world-space start position.
Transform this end position to clip-space.
*   **Blending:** Requires `GL_MAX` blending (or similar non-additive blending) to prevent lines from brightening excessively when overlapping.
If the input positions are not in this range, the sampling will be incorrect.
*   **Velocity Magnitude:** The velocity vector is added directly to the position.
If the magnitude is too large, the line may extend beyond the view frustum or cause clipping issues.
*   **When not to use:** Unstructured particle systems (use [GPU Particle Rendering via Geometry Shader](4444-gpu-particle-rendering-via-geometry-shader.md)) or when additive blending is desired.
